subject: add matrix to plot using facet_plot

messages.author: 3edeb563ff8976a1
messages.subject: add matrix to plot using facet_plot
parts:
I would like to plot a matrix such as p6 in the below code using facet_plot in ggtree, I am attempting to do this in p5 but am stuck

any ideas?

library(ggstance)
library(ggtree)
library(reshape)

tr <- rtree(30)
p <- ggtree(tr)
p <- p + geom_tiplab(size=3) + xlim_tree(4)
d1 <- data.frame(id=tr$tip.label, location=sample(c("GZ", "HK", "CZ"), 30, replace=TRUE))
p1 <- p %<+% d1 + geom_tippoint(aes(color=location))
d2 <- data.frame(id=tr$tip.label, val=rnorm(30, sd=3))
p2 <- facet_plot(p1, panel="dot", data=d2, geom=geom_point,
                 aes(x=val), color='firebrick') + theme_tree2()

d3 <- data.frame(id = rep(tr$tip.label, each=2),
                 value = abs(rnorm(60, mean=100, sd=50)),
                 category = rep(LETTERS[1:2], 30))
p3 <- facet_plot(p2, panel = 'Stacked Barplot', data = d3,
                 geom = geom_barh,
                 mapping = aes(x = value, fill = as.factor(category)),
                 stat='identity' )

p4 <- facet_plot(p1, panel="my bar", data=d3, geom=geom_barh,
                 mapping = aes(x = value, fill = as.factor(category)),
                 stat='identity' )  + theme_tree2()


m <- 30
n <- 15
m1 <- as.data.frame(matrix(sample(0:1, m * n, replace = TRUE), m, n))

m1$id <- tr$tip.label

m2 <- melt(m1[,c(ncol(m1),1:(ncol(m1)-1))])

p5 <- facet_plot(p3, panel="my matrix", data=m2, geom=geom_point,
                 mapping = aes(x = value))  + theme_tree2()

p6 <- ggplot(m2, aes(x = variable, y = id)) +
  geom_raster(aes(fill=value)) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low="white", high="red")

messages.author: cec41188340e8212
messages.subject: Re: add matrix to plot using facet_plot
parts:
see https://github.com/GuangchuangYu/ggtree/issues/82.

facet_plot(p2, panel='matrix', data=m2, geom=geom_tile, aes(x=as.numeric(variable), fill=value))

If you want to use p3, the same issue happened, as fill = as.factor(category) in p3, and now you want to fill = value for m2, and it will throw the following error:

Error: Continuous value supplied to discrete scale

If the m2$value is binary, you need to convert it to factor and it will work smoothly.

facet_plot(p3, panel='matrix', data=m2, geom=geom_tile, aes(x=as.numeric(variable), fill=as.factor(value)))
​
